name: orchestra
description: Sol-led strategy routing with explicit native context policy and pinned subagents

interface.shortDescription: Strategy-first orchestration with explicit context policy.
interface.longDescription: Keeps Sol / High as manager, selects a workflow strategy and native context inheritance before choosing pinned Luna, Terra, or fresh Sol lanes, and limits delegated context to evidence-backed packets.
defaultPrompt: Use $orchestra:orchestration to choose a strategy before tools, then execute and verify this task.
Select native fork_turns explicitly; keep packets evidence-scoped and reviewers context-clean.
